title: Auto-Research Arena: Benchmarking and Advancing Auto-Research in Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.35866v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress. We introduce Auto-Research Arena, a multi-target benchmark for evaluating autonomous research systems and discovering ideas in language modeling. Arena supports diverse research objectives within a shared experimental environment by separating admissibility from improvement: model quality and resource constraints determine whether a result qualifies, while the selected target measures progress among admissible results. We instantiate Arena in language model pretraining with nine targets spanning model, data, training, and inference efficiency, and evaluate seven research harnesses using two foundation models. translated_title: 自动研究竞技场：语言建模中自动研究的基准评估与推进
translated_abstract: 随着自主研究系统的能力不断增强，基准测试必须既能评估其性能，又能支持有意义的研究进展。我们提出了Auto-Research Arena，这是一个多目标基准，用于评估自主研究系统并发现语言建模领域的新想法。Arena通过将“可行性”与“改进程度”相分离，在共享的实验环境中支持多样化的研究目标：模型质量和资源约束决定一个结果是否符合条件，而所选定的目标则在符合条件的结果之间衡量进展。我们在语言模型预训练任务中实例化了Arena，涵盖模型、数据、训练和推理效率共九个研究目标，并使用两个基础模型评估了七个研究框架。Arena能够清晰地区分现有研究框架在不同研究目标上的表现，其中一些复杂的方法甚至不如我们简单的顺序搜索基线，这表明该领域仍有巨大的提升空间。
tldr: 提出了多目标基准Auto-Research Arena，通过将可行性与改进程度分离来评估语言建模中的自主研究系统，并发现现有复杂研究框架甚至不如简单的顺序搜索基线，揭示了该领域巨大的改进空间。
en_tdlr: Auto-Research Arena is a multi-target benchmark that evaluates autonomous research systems in language modeling by separating admissibility from improvement, revealing that even sophisticated research harnesses can be outperformed by a simple sequential search baseline, indicating substantial headroom for progress.
